item.title: Tell HN: My open-source form builder has reached ~7k registered users
item.summary: Project is: https://forms.md That's the post really. It recently reached ~7k registered users, and it's feels amazing. I built the project before the AI boom, and it's "hand-written". Revenue is small, but it doesn't really matter. I'm trying to monetize the WordPress plugin, which is more of a product: https://wp.forms.md Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49308631 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
